connector.name: Filechanger
connector.registryDescription: Convert documents between text formats (markdown, html, and more) via the FileChanger API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package filechanger-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.filechanger, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FILECHANGER_API_KEY
env.description: FileChanger API key (fc_...). Get one at https://filechanger.io.

env.name: FILECHANGER_URL
env.description: Override the MCP endpoint. Defaults to https://filechanger.io/mcp.
